concerns.location: plan.md:Constitution Check table, row for Principle II
concerns.text: The plan asserts that “All external GWAS and dataset citations are drawn from the verified list” (Constitution Check table), but the accompanying research.md explicitly states that none of the listed datasets have a verified source (e.g., “NO verified source found”). This contradicts Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) and makes the plan’s reproducibility claim false.

The output schema (contracts/output.schema.yaml) requires a column `vulnerability_window`, yet the Phase 3 description only mentions producing `disorder_enrichment.csv` without specifying that this column will be included. This creates a mismatch between the plan and the contract schema.
The `hubs` field in the data model uses a placeholder “[deferred]” for the degree threshold, but the plan never defines or defers this metric elsewhere, leaving the definition ambiguous.
